title: Research pass — Katherine Hsiao WEF council chronology root
summary: Starts the chronology root by fixing the directly evidenced 2023-2024 Data Equity interval, preserving the undated Data Policy service claim, and selecting historical Data Policy term calibration as the first follow-up.

sources.title: Data Equity:Foundational Concepts for Generative AI

data.research_question: What is the first defensible chronology boundary for Hsiao's two WEF council relationships?
data.method: Date exact person-roster artifacts and keep relative profile statements unresolved.
classification_rules: A current profile's relative-time wording does not create exact historical dates.
A council output date proves council activity, not every past member's presence on that date.
A dated contributor roster may establish a person-level interval when it explicitly labels the council term.

findings.finding: Hsiao is directly fixed to the 2023-2024 Data Equity council term by report contributor rosters.
Hsiao's earlier Data Policy service is WEF-confirmed but not yet dated at person level.
